flags.check: Read the S-3/424B5 for size vs market cap and whether an ATM sales agreement exists.
Serial 424B supplements: an 8-K item 1.01 within 2 days usually marks an underwritten follow-on (read the price vs today); without it, suspect an active ATM and size the overhang.
Open the 8-K exhibit: customer/supply/financing agreement? counterparty quality?
New 13G/13D filers = institutional discovery or activist; read filer name and %.
Classify open-market buys (code P) vs sales/grants; buys after a run-up are rarer signals.
